assets.name: 草の株
notes: 2026-09-11 rework requested by the user: the v1 dense needle-blade tuft looked unsettling. v2 has nine broad smooth blades.

Dense 296,779 -> 44,457 triangles; quadric collapse stalls at 35k on the open blade edges, so the 44k probe (p95 0.3 mm) is delivered. Full mesh is only drawn within 1.1 m; impostors beyond, as before (was 134,051 triangles).
Height 0.55 m, ground-centred pivot; crops (fire-root, herb) reuse this model with their tints. No LOD delivered (same as v1).

2026-09-11 root recolour requested by the user ("no brown at the grass root"): TRELLIS had baked the reference soil into the lowest 18% of the blades. scripts/recolor-grass-root.mjs re-hues the non-green/dull texels the lowest 18% of the vertices reference to the leaf-green chromaticity at each texel's own luminance (shading kept); geometry, UVs and normals are byte-identical. Root band mean RGB 111,104,68 (86% ochre) -> 63,117,42 (0% ochre).

2026-09-12 root cap removed (user: green base under grass): TRELLIS had sealed the bottom of the clump with a nearly flat root disc (285 flat triangles within +-0.12 m) that the root recolour turned into a green mound. scripts/cut-grass-root.mjs drops every triangle whose highest vertex is below 0.045 m (44,457 -> 43,848 triangles, 609 removed); vertices, normals, UVs, material and texture are byte-identical and the height is unchanged. The placement sink (world-scenery.ts / regional-scenery.ts) was raised so the cut edge sits below the ground.

2026-09-12 follow-up by Codex: the earlier cut left the disc top visible. Removed all triangles below 0.08 m (1261 more triangles; 42587 remain), including the full horizontal cap. All source vertices, UVs, normals, texture and material remain byte-identical. The grass sink now scales with plant size. Exact candidates reviewed in real Chrome close meshes (12 tufts / 7 sprigs), normal impostors, overhead, two meadow areas and travel return; no light-green pedestals remain. Original candidate revisions are retained.
